Admins can now change a user's role from the users table. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, so none of this has been run or type-checked.

- **API:** `features/users/api/update-user-role.ts` sends `PATCH /users/{userId}/role` with `{ role }`, validated by a Zod schema for `ADMIN` or `USER`. On success it invalidates the users list using `getUsersQueryOptions().queryKey`, so the list refetches and shows the new role. `docs/state-management.md` requires that rather than a literal key array.
- **UI:** `features/users/components/update-user-role.tsx` renders a role select in each row. Admins see the dropdown, and everyone else sees the role as plain text. After a successful change it shows a "User Role Updated" success notification, the same way `DeleteUser` does. I wired it into the Role column of `users-list.tsx`.
- **Mock backend:** I added a `PATCH /users/:userId/role` handler to `testing/mocks/handlers/users.ts`. It requires an admin and only updates users in the same team.

An admin can also change their own role from the table, which could lock them out of the admin controls. I didn't block that, because you didn't ask for it.

I didn't create or update `notes/`, since the project has none.
